dct_description_sm: Most bird species nesting in the Eyjafjarar river delta region breed widely in Iceland and nearly all are common. Pintail is the rarest species country-wide and listed on the Icelandic Red List together with Grey-lag Goose and Common Gull. The Eyjafjrur region is the most important breeding region by far for Common Gull in Iceland. Both Common Gull and Black-headed Gull have been monitored in that region every 5th year since 1990 for changes in breeding birds, species composition and population size.
dct_title_s: Eyjafjarar Delta Monitoring Program, Eyf, Iceland
